title: Past the stairs
instruction: With the large window to your right, head forward and to your left until you reach the base of some stairs leading upwards. Continue past the stairs and towards some more stairs leading downwards. Pass to the right of those second stairs and down a narrow hallway with the banister on your left and some artwork on the wall towards your right. Enter the next room on your right when you reach it.

title: Through the house
instruction: leave sitting room and head towards the kitchen, turn right at living room and enter. walk through living room to dinning room and enter. Turn left and head to front door. Exit the house and stop on porch.
playback: Source timing, 3 frames per second; no motion interpolation.

title: Into the bedroom
instruction: Walk forward and turn right, exiting the room. Continue forward and turn right, walking past the mirror and side table. Enter the bedroom and turn left. Turn left again and wait inside the doorway.
playback: Source timing, 3 frames per second; no motion interpolation.

title: Across connected rooms
instruction: Okay now you are in front of a mirror and to the back of you, there is a bed. Now turn left and in front of you, there is a open entrance. Now move out of this entrance and then take right and move forward a little bit and in front of you, there is a closed entrance. Now turn left and move forward and now to the right of you, there is a sink and to the left there is a cupboard and there are some plates and cups in it. Now move forward in a straight path. Now to the left of you, there is a open entrance. Now move forward a little bit and in front of you, there is a frame on the wall and to the left there is a open entrance and to the right also there is a another open entrance. Now move towards the right side entrance and move forward, until you reach a black color chair and a window in front of you. Now stop here and this is your final destination.
